title: pool slot: stale fd in slot after acquire causes double-close in cleanup
description: crypto2dev_pool_acquire sets slots[i].in_use=1 but does NOT clear slots[i].fd. The caller takes the fd and later calls close(fd). If wc_crypto2dev_cleanup runs before crypto2dev_pool_release returns, pool_cleanup iterates all slots, sees fd >= 0 (the stale, already-closed value), and calls close(stale_fd) — double close. If the OS has reassigned that fd number to another file, this closes the wrong fd. Trigger: concurrent cleanup + in-flight operation (violates documented contract, but the bug is silent when violated). Fix: set slots[i].fd = -1 in crypto2dev_pool_acquire immediately after recording the fd value.
